Summary

COPAUS1C is an online CICS COBOL program within the CardDemo Authorization Module that provides a detailed view of a pending authorization message for a given account. It allows users to view authorization details such as card number, transaction amount, merchant information, and response codes, and also enables marking or removing a fraud flag on a specific authorization record. The program interacts with an IMS database to read and update pending authorization segments, and delegates fraud processing to a linked program (COPAUS2C).
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: IMS - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Initialize error flags, erase flags, and clear message fields at program startup 2: New Session Redirect - When no communication area exists, redirect user back to the Authorization Summary screen 3: First Entry Processing - On first entry to the screen, load and display the authorization detail record for the selected authorization 4: Screen Navigation Handling - Evaluate user keystrokes (Enter, PF3, PF5, PF8) and route to appropriate processing routines 5: Return to Authorization Summary - On PF3 key press, navigate back to the Authorization Summary screen 6: Mark/Unmark Authorization as Fraud - On PF5 key press, toggle the fraud status of the current authorization record (mark as fraud or remove fraud flag) 7: Navigate to Next Authorization - On PF8 key press, advance to the next authorization detail record for the account 8: Invalid Key Handling - Display an invalid key message when an unsupported function key is pressed 9: Authorization Record Retrieval - Read the authorization summary and detail records from the database using the account ID and authorization key 10: Next Authorization Record Retrieval - Read the next sequential authorization detail record from the database for forward navigation 11: End of Authorization Records Detection - Detect when there are no more authorization records and display 'Already at the last Authorization' message 12: Authorization Detail Display Population - Populate screen fields with authorization details including card number, date, time, amount, response code, decline reason, processing code, POS entry mode, message source, merchant category code, card expiry date, authorization type, transaction ID, match status, fraud status, and merchant information 13: Authorization Response Code Interpretation - Determine if authorization was Approved (code '00') or Declined and display appropriate indicator with color coding (green for approved, red for declined) 14: Decline Reason Code Lookup - Search the decline reason table to find and display the description corresponding to the authorization response reason code 15: Fraud Status Display - Display fraud flag and fraud report date if the authorization has been confirmed as fraud or had fraud removed; otherwise display a dash 16: Fraud Confirmation Toggle - When marking fraud, check current fraud status: if already confirmed as fraud then remove it, if not fraudulent then mark it as fraud 17: Fraud Processing Delegation - Pass authorization details, account ID, and customer ID to the fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) for fraud status update 18: Fraud Update Success Handling - If fraud program returns success, update the authorization detail record in the database and display success message ('AUTH MARKED FRAUD' or 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED') 19: Fraud Update Failure Handling - If fraud program returns failure, rollback database changes and display the error message returned from the fraud program 20: Authorization Detail Record Update - Save updated authorization details (with new fraud status and report date) back to the database 21: Transaction Commit - Commit database changes after a successful authorization detail update 22: Transaction Rollback - Rollback database changes when an error occurs during fraud tagging or update operations 23: Screen Header Population - Populate screen header with application title, transaction ID, program name, current date, and current time 24: Authorization Detail Screen Display - Send the populated authorization detail screen to the user terminal, with full erase or partial refresh depending on navigation context 25: Screen Input Receipt - Receive user input from the authorization detail screen 26: Date and Time Formatting - Format authorization original date from YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY display format and format time with colon separators for display 27: Card Expiry Date Formatting - Format card expiry date by inserting a slash separator between month and year for display

Datasource Information (2)

Datasource Name Type Usage
PAUTSUM0 IMS Segment Read (GU) - Retrieves the Pending Authorization Summary (root segment) for a given account ID
PAUTDTL1 IMS Segment Read (GNP) and Update (REPL) - Retrieves and updates the Pending Authorization Details (child segment) for a specific authorization key, including fraud tagging

**1. MAIN-PARA – Entry Point and Key Handling** This is the main control paragraph. It initializes flags, checks if the communication area exists, and routes processing based on whether this is the first entry or a re-entry, and which function key was pressed. ```cobol MAIN-PARA. SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE SET SEND-ERASE-YES TO TRUE MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE ERRMSGO OF COPAU1AO IF EIBCALEN = 0 INITIALIZE CARDDEMO-COMMAREA MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN ELSE MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA MOVE SPACES TO CDEMO-CPVD-FRAUD-DATA IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN ELSE PERFORM RECEIVE-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF3 MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF5 PERFORM MARK-AUTH-FRAUD PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF8 PERFORM PROCESS-PF8-KEY PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN WHEN OTHER PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN END-EVALUATE END-IF END-IF EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID) COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) END-EXEC ``` --- **2. SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN – Sending the BMS Screen** Populates the header, moves the message to the error field, and sends the BMS map to the terminal. Uses ERASE on first display, otherwise sends without erase. ```cobol SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN. PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COPAU1AO MOVE -1 TO CARDNUML IF SEND-ERASE-YES EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COPAU1A') MAPSET('COPAU01') FROM(COPAU1AO) ERASE CURSOR END-EXEC ELSE EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COPAU1A') MAPSET('COPAU01') FROM(COPAU1AO) CURSOR END-EXEC END-IF ``` --- **3. RECEIVE-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN – Receiving Input from the BMS Screen** Receives user input from the BMS map into the input map structure COPAU1AI. ```cobol RECEIVE-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COPAU1A') MAPSET('COPAU01') INTO(COPAU1AI) NOHANDLE END-EXEC ``` --- **4. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO – Populating Screen Header Fields** Gets the current date and time and populates the header fields of the BMS map output area: transaction name, program name, title lines, date, and time. ```cobol POPULATE-HEADER-INFO. MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COPAU1AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COPAU1AO MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COPAU1AO MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL TO PGMNAMEO OF COPAU1AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COPAU1AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COPAU1AO ``` --- **5. POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS – Populating Authorization Detail Fields on Screen** Moves all authorization detail data from the IMS segment into the BMS output map fields. Handles date/time formatting, response code color coding (green=Approved, red=Declined), decline reason lookup, card expiry formatting, fraud status display, and merchant details. ```cobol POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS. IF ERR-FLG-OFF MOVE PA-CARD-NUM TO CARDNUMO MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(1:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(5:2) TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO WS-AUTH-DATE MOVE WS-AUTH-DATE TO AUTHDTO MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(1:2) TO WS-AUTH-TIME(1:2) MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(3:2) TO WS-AUTH-TIME(4:2) MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(5:2) TO WS-AUTH-TIME(7:2) MOVE WS-AUTH-TIME TO AUTHTMO MOVE PA-APPROVED-AMT TO WS-AUTH-AMT MOVE WS-AUTH-AMT TO AUTHAMTO IF PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE = '00' MOVE 'A' TO AUTHRSPO MOVE DFHGREEN TO AUTHRSPC ELSE MOVE 'D' TO AUTHRSPO MOVE DFHRED TO AUTHRSPC END-IF SEARCH ALL WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB AT END MOVE '9999' TO AUTHRSNO MOVE '-' TO AUTHRSNO(5:1) MOVE 'ERROR' TO AUTHRSNO(6:) WHEN DECL-CODE(WS-DECL-RSN-IDX) = PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON MOVE PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON TO AUTHRSNO MOVE '-' TO AUTHRSNO(5:1) MOVE DECL-DESC(WS-DECL-RSN-IDX) TO AUTHRSNO(6:) END-SEARCH MOVE PA-PROCESSING-CODE TO AUTHCDO MOVE PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE TO POSEMDO MOVE PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE TO AUTHSRCO MOVE PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE TO MCCCDO MOVE PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE(1:2) TO CRDEXPO(1:2) MOVE '/' TO CRDEXPO(3:1) MOVE PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE(3:2) TO CRDEXPO(4:2) MOVE PA-AUTH-TYPE TO AUTHTYPO MOVE PA-TRANSACTION-ID TO TRNIDO MOVE PA-MATCH-STATUS TO AUTHMTCO IF PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED OR PA-FRAUD-REMOVED MOVE PA-AUTH-FRAUD TO AUTHFRDO(1:1) MOVE '-' TO AUTHFRDO(2:1) MOVE PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE TO AUTHFRDO(3:) ELSE MOVE '-' TO AUTHFRDO END-IF MOVE PA-MERCHANT-NAME TO MERNAMEO MOVE PA-MERCHANT-ID TO MERIDO MOVE PA-MERCHANT-CITY TO MERCITYO MOVE PA-MERCHANT-STATE TO MERSTO MOVE PA-MERCHANT-ZIP TO MERZIPO END-IF ``` --- **6. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY – Processing Enter Key Action** Clears the output map, validates the account ID and selected authorization key from the communication area, reads the authorization record from IMS, and populates the screen details. ```cobol PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COPAU1AO IF CDEMO-ACCT-ID IS NUMERIC AND CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID TO WS-ACCT-ID MOVE CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED TO WS-AUTH-KEY PERFORM READ-AUTH-RECORD IF IMS-PSB-SCHD SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD TO TRUE PERFORM TAKE-SYNCPOINT END-IF ELSE SET ERR-FLG-ON TO TRUE END-IF PERFORM POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS ``` --- **7. PROCESS-PF8-KEY – Processing PF8 (Next Authorization) Key** Reads the current authorization record and then reads the next authorization detail record. If no more records exist, sets a message indicating the user is at the last authorization. Otherwise, updates the selected key and populates the screen with the next record. ```cobol PROCESS-PF8-KEY. MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID TO WS-ACCT-ID MOVE CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED TO WS-AUTH-KEY PERFORM READ-AUTH-RECORD PERFORM READ-NEXT-AUTH-RECORD IF IMS-PSB-SCHD SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD TO TRUE PERFORM TAKE-SYNCPOINT END-IF IF AUTHS-EOF SET SEND-ERASE-NO TO TRUE MOVE 'Already at the last Authorization...' TO WS-MESSAGE ELSE MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED PERFORM POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS END-IF ``` --- **8. MARK-AUTH-FRAUD – Processing PF5 (Mark/Remove Fraud) Key** Reads the current authorization record. Toggles the fraud flag: if already confirmed as fraud, removes it; if not flagged, marks it as fraud. Calls the fraud update program (COPAUS2C) via CICS LINK. On success, updates the IMS record. On failure, rolls back changes. Updates the screen with the result. ```cobol MARK-AUTH-FRAUD. MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID TO WS-ACCT-ID MOVE CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED TO WS-AUTH-KEY PERFORM READ-AUTH-RECORD IF PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED SET PA-FRAUD-REMOVED TO TRUE SET WS-REMOVE-FRAUD TO TRUE ELSE SET PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED TO TRUE SET WS-REPORT-FRAUD TO TRUE END-IF MOVE PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS TO WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID TO WS-FRD-ACCT-ID MOVE CDEMO-CUST-ID TO WS-FRD-CUST-ID EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM(WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) COMMAREA(WS-FRAUD-DATA) NOHANDLE END-EXEC IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL) IF WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS PERFORM UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS ELSE MOVE WS-FRD-ACT-MSG TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM ROLL-BACK END-IF ELSE PERFORM ROLL-BACK END-IF MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED PERFORM POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS ``` --- **9. UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS – Writing Fraud Update to Screen Message** After a successful IMS update of the fraud flag, sets the appropriate confirmation message to be displayed in the ERRMSG field on the screen. ```cobol UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS. ... EVALUATE TRUE WHEN STATUS-OK PERFORM TAKE-SYNCPOINT IF PA-FRAUD-REMOVED MOVE 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' TO WS-MESSAGE ELSE MOVE 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' TO WS-MESSAGE END-IF WHEN OTHER ... STRING ' System error while FRAUD Tagging, ROLLBACK||' IMS-RETURN-CODE DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE END-STRING PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ```

Business Rules
